title: Al Hibbler friendship and drinking
summary: Albert knew Hibbler as a Little Rock kid, used him in San Antonio; his drinking was the flaw.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Roland Kirk. Roland Kirk. I've never met him. Oh, he's a very nice guy. Of course naturally being blonde he has certain feelings. Right, right. Well that was the same way with Al Hibbler.
You know, Al Hibbler and I were great friends and I heard Al Hibbler when he was a kid in Little Rock, Arkansas.

And he want to join my band and he had sung some numbers with me. He'd sung some numbers with me. I'd already had a singer, so I... Later years he came to San Antonio, I used him at my nightclub, and then he went to Jim, like Shannon's band from J-Bone, to Duke's band, which I think was great. Only bad feature about Al, him, has always been his drinking problem. Being blind, he thought that, you know, people couldn't tell that. I imagine that's how you felt, but you can always tell when you felt it's not right. Yeah. Small. But, he was a great singer. Beautiful. Well, Dick, you're going to go to school now, so anyhow, I'm going to call my boy up and have him come and get him. And in the meantime, save these write-ups for me, and when you write and ask the questions, just give me enough space. Yeah. Let's hurry up and get this book on the way, man.
